Definition: from G1909 and G4741; to support further, i.e. reestablish:--confirm, strengthen.
BiblicalUsage: Episterizo means to strengthen, to confirm, to establish again — to put support under what is already standing. Paul and Barnabas confirm the souls of the disciples, exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that we must through much tribulation enter into the kingdom of God; Judas and Silas exhort and confirm the brethren with many words.
TheologicalSignificance: The gospel plants, and then someone must return to strengthen — and tribulation is part of the strengthening, not a sign it failed. I hold that confirmation is the apostles' second visit, and the church still needs it: souls confirmed, not merely converted.
RelatedPeople: Paul; Barnabas; Silas; Judas, Son of James
RelatedEvents: Paul and Barnabas at Iconium; Jerusalem Council
